name: Dennis Koshta
shortBio: I build AI systems, tools, games, and simulations. I like learning new things and putting them into practice.
aboutParagraphs: I like learning how things work, trying unfamiliar ideas, and getting better at making things. A project is often my excuse to learn something new.

AI is my main focus. I’m excited about what it could do for science, education, and human progress. That’s also why I care about safety and alignment: I want those advances to benefit people over the long term.

experience.description: Building agent evaluation systems, document-review tools, and knowledge-base infrastructure.
Built retrieval systems, LLM integrations, and backend infrastructure.
Led a four-person team building RL and LLM agents, including a Minecraft agent.
Co-founded an AI analytics platform and built its private beta.

experience.role: Machine Learning and Data Teams Lead · Project Manager
experience.description: Led ML and data work on classifying subvocal phonemes from muscle signals.

education.description: B.S. in Computer Science and B.S. in Mathematics Theory and Computation, with a minor in Statistics. Graduated in 2025.

imageSource: Headshot supplied directly by Dennis Koshta for this portfolio.

aboutSections.title: Other interests
paragraphs: I enjoy math, biology, and physics, including quantum physics. Outside that, I’m into prog rock, cooking, and backpacking.

aboutSections.title: Building with AI
paragraphs: I use Codex and Claude Code extensively. I choose the direction, test the results, and refine the work. Individual project pages explain the collaboration and what I contributed.
